stem.text: The DNA of typical prokaryotes is naked and circular.
Which statement describes how the DNA of eukaryotes differs from the DNA of typical prokaryotes?

A.text: Only DNA of eukaryotes has a nuclear envelope around it and is a double helix.

B.text: Only DNA of eukaryotes has a nuclear envelope around it and is circular.

C.text: Only DNA of eukaryotes has proteins attached to it and is a double helix.

D.text: Only DNA of eukaryotes has proteins attached to it and is linear.
